panel.label: Brainstorm
brainstorm.title: Brainstorm
brainstorm.subtitle: Start from a vague idea: interview to align, then confirm research.
brainstorm.statementBuilding: AI is drafting the problem statement…
brainstorm.commentPlaceholder: Add a comment on this research result…
brainstorm.reviseHint: Tell AI how to rewrite this result; existing comments are included.
brainstorm.revisePlaceholder: e.g. make competitor notes more concrete and add risks…
brainstorm.researchHint: Optional: add research requirements, scope, or focus; leave blank to draft from the node and path.
brainstorm.researchPlaceholder: e.g. compare competitor pricing for indie developers…
brainstorm.emptyBody: Add an idea to start an interview, or diverge / confirm research from the toolbar.
brainstorm.canvasHint: Drag blank space to pan · double-click to add a node · scroll to zoom · drag moves the subtree · Delete removes the selection
brainstorm.outlineGenerating: AI is drafting a research outline…
brainstorm.modalAddHint: Write down an idea or user problem you want to explore.
brainstorm.modalAddPlaceholder: Example: a tool that organizes user feedback for indie developers…
brainstorm.modalModifyHint: Tell AI how you want this node changed.
brainstorm.modalModifyPlaceholder: Example: make the conclusion more specific and add risks and next steps…
brainstorm.kind.question: AI question
brainstorm.outlineNeedTwoPoints: An outline needs at least two points.
brainstorm.pointsNeedOne: Keep at least one bullet point.
brainstorm.outlineConfirmed: Confirmed; results appear in the following node
brainstorm.deleteSubtree: This will also delete {count} downstream node(s).
brainstorm.emptyBoardsHint: Create a canvas and start from an idea.
brainstorm.deleteBoardHint: This cannot be undone. The canvas data will be removed.
brainstorm.boardEmptyHint: Double-click the canvas to add your first idea; submitting starts an interview by default.
brainstorm.canvasErrorHint: Refresh the page and try again. If it persists, check the console.
brainstorm.updateConfirmHint: Upgrade from {current} to {latest}. This runs pnpm in your current profile.
brainstorm.updateDoneRestart: The new version is installed. Restart DeepSeek Harness for it to take effect (a page refresh is not enough).
brainstorm.updateDoneReload: The new version is installed. Hot-reload is available — refresh the page to load it.
brainstorm.updateFailed: Upgrade failed. Try again later or install the new version from Plugin Manager.
